Defect Summary: Salary of zero is allowed, but a minus salary is blocked
Observed Behaviour: A salary of -5000 is blocked. A salary of 0 is saved and the job goes live.
Why It Matters: The check blocks anything below zero, but not zero itself. So it stops one value too early. A job with zero salary is shown to jobseekers with no explanation.

Defect Summary: An empty search shows no jobs at all
Observed Behaviour: Pressing search with the box empty gives an empty screen. No jobs are listed.
Why It Matters: An empty search should show all jobs, or ask the user to type something. Showing nothing makes a working site look broken. It is easy to hit by pressing enter in an empty box.

Defect Summary: No message when a search or filter finds nothing
Observed Behaviour: A word that matches no job, and a location with no jobs, both leave an empty area with no text.
Why It Matters: The user cannot tell if nothing matched or the page failed to load. One line saying no jobs found would fix it.

Defect Summary: Search does not look at the job description
Observed Behaviour: Searching for a word that is in a job description, but not in its title, finds nothing.
Why It Matters: A jobseeker looking for a skill named in the description will not find the job. The team may have done this on purpose to keep results tight.

Defect Summary: The message does not say which field is missing
Observed Behaviour: Leaving any field empty gives Please fill all the information. The same message shows whether one field or all nine are empty.
Why It Matters: On a form with nine fields, the user has to hunt for the one they missed. Naming the field, or marking it on the form, would remove the guesswork.

Defect Summary: Messages do not always start with a capital letter
Observed Behaviour: please Enter Valid salary starts with a small letter. Please Enter valid position and Please Enter valid Title start with a capital.
Why It Matters: Small differences like this stand out on a page where the user is already stuck. Cheap to fix, and worth listing so all the messages get corrected together.
